blocks.p: Synthetic document for evaluation. Example Widgets Inc. is a fictional company.

This standard sets how Example Widgets Inc. grants, reviews and removes access to internal systems, following the principle of least privilege: each person gets only the access their current job needs.
It covers all 1,400 staff and contractors and every system connected to single sign-on (SSO), about 180 applications.

blocks.li: Access is granted through roles (RBAC), never to individuals directly.
Each role has an owner who approves every request for it.
Administrator roles also require MFA with a hardware key.

blocks.p: Every quarter, managers re-certify each person's roles. A role not re-certified within 14 days is removed automatically.
Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours. When someone changes team, their old roles expire after 30 days unless re-approved.
Orphaned accounts are accounts whose owner has left. The drop from 22 to 5 followed the switch to automatic disabling through SSO.
